description: Compress video files to fit upload limits (such as GitHub PRs under 10MB or Discord under 25MB) using target file sizes or CRF quality levels. Does not modify the original file.

crf.description: Quality value between 18 (higher quality) and 45 (smaller file). Overrides preset.

hardwareAcceleration.description: Use hardware-accelerated video encoding (VideoToolbox, NVENC, QSV, etc.) when available. Default: true.

inputPath.description: Path to the source video file (e.g. './recordings/demo.mov')

maxWidth.description: Maximum video width in pixels, such as 1280 for 720p. Keeps aspect ratio.

outputPath.description: Destination path for the compressed MP4 file (e.g. './recordings/demo_compressed.mp4')

preset.description: Preset when targetSizeMB is not set: 'github_pr', 'discord', 'email', 'balanced', or 'high_quality'. Default: 'balanced'.

targetSizeMB.description: Target output size in megabytes, such as 9.5 for GitHub or 24 for Discord. Computes bitrates from duration.

name: compress_video
